en: Colorized panoramic view of the city of Brașov surrounded by hills. The foreground shows dense urban buildings with red roofs, while in the background a large green hill with structures on top dominates the scene. The caption "Brașov" appears below the image. The reverse side is a divided-back postcard layout with printed Romanian text indicating it is a postal card from Romania and a small line of publisher information dated 1930.
